title: 第一卷 第19章 车子在动
content_zh:
车子再宽敞，也狭窄。

    就前面这个位置，真不是霍放之前说的，比她家里大。

    童喻知道她刚才动的这一下动到哪里了，她不是没有察觉。

    但，动都动了，碰也碰了，能怎么办？

    童喻忽视腰间那只手掌的热度，她赶紧把手机开机，忽略掉涌进来的信息提醒，打开微信赶紧扫码把霍放加上。

    加上后，她提醒着霍放，“通过一下。”

    霍放在她眼里只看到对加上他微信的那种迫切，她丝毫没有在意现在他俩的姿势。

    他通过后，就看到童喻发来的信息。

    一串数字。

    “我的手机号码。”童喻觉得，他们还是有必要记下彼此的手机号码的。

    霍放眼角带着痞痞的笑意，修长的手指点了一下那串号码，直接拨过去。

    童喻的手机响了。

    看着那串数字，童喻如愿保存。

    存好后，她拿给他看。

    霍放扫向那个名字。

    放。

    霍放轻蹙眉头，这一个字，让他想到了她锁骨上的那个纹身。

    “你这戏，做得有点太真了。”

    童喻放好手机，“怎么就不能是我当真了呢？”

    霍放根本就不信。

    她那点小心思，他看得透透的。

    “微信加了，电话要了。你是不是要给我点什么。”

    霍放对童喻的兴趣大到超乎他的想象。

    他都不敢相信，这个女人已经在他梦里出现过好几次。

    都是赤诚相待的画面。

    男人想要的太裸露，童喻心里有数。

    他不跟她走心，摆明就是看中她的人。

    男人对你好，不可能什么都不图。

    童喻那晚是喝多了，确实没有什么印象。

    这会儿清醒着，又在车里，还在常住的小区。

    坐在他腿上，已经是很大胆了。

    再要在这里做点事，刺激感将她牢牢包裹着。

    跟在街上裸奔没什么区别。

    童喻自找的，人也撩了，该要的也要到了，现在坐在他腿上，下不去，就只有上了。

    忽然，霍放的身体又往后仰了些。

    他把座椅完全调倒可以躺平的角度。

    手已经从她腰上拿开，举过头顶，整个人都呈现出最放松的状态。
content_en:
No matter how spacious the car is, it is also narrow.

    The location in front is really not what Huo Fang said before, it is bigger than her home.

    Tong Yu knew where she had moved just now, and it was not that she didn't notice it.

    But, even if it moves and touches, what can I do?

    Tong Yu ignored the heat of the palm on her waist. She quickly turned on her phone, ignored the incoming message reminders, opened WeChat and quickly scanned the code to add Huo Fang.

    After adding it, she reminded Huo Fang, "Pass it."

    Huo Fang only saw in her eyes the eagerness to add him on WeChat, and she didn't care at all about their current postures.

    After he passed, he saw the message from Tong Yu.

    A string of numbers.

    "My mobile phone number." Tong Yu felt that they still needed to write down each other's mobile phone numbers.

    With a naughty smile in his eyes, Huo Fang clicked on the number with his slender fingers and dialed it directly.

    Tong Yu's cell phone rang.

    Looking at the string of numbers, Tong Yu saved it as he wished.

    After saving it, she showed it to him.

    Huo Fang glanced at the name.

    put.

    Huo Fang frowned slightly. This word reminded him of the tattoo on her collarbone.

    "Your play is a bit too real."

    Tong Yu put down her phone, "Why can't I take it seriously?"

    Huo Fang didn't believe it at all.

    He could see through her little thoughts.

    "I added it on WeChat and asked for the phone number. Do you want to give me something?"

    Huo Fang's interest in Tong Yu was beyond his imagination.

    He couldn't believe that this woman had appeared in his dreams several times.

    They are all scenes of treating each other sincerely.

    The man wanted too much nudity, and Tong Yu knew it.

    He doesn't follow her, he is clearly the one who likes her.

    It is impossible for a man to treat you well without any intention.

    Tong Yu drank too much that night and really had no memory.

    Now I'm awake, in the car, and in my usual neighborhood.

    Sitting on his lap was already very bold.

    If she wanted to do something here again, the excitement would wrap her tightly around her.

    It's no different than running naked on the street.

    Tong Yu asked for it, he was teased by others, and what he wanted was about to come. Now he was sitting on his lap. He couldn't get down, so he had to get up.

    Suddenly, Huo Fang's body leaned back further.

    He tilted the seat completely so that he could lie flat.

    His hands had been taken away from her waist and raised above her head. Her whole body was in the most relaxed state.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 19 The car is moving
